subject: Classic Era capability source evidence; research only

retrieval.boundary: Positive spell capabilities and faction/race evidence only. Not an exhaustive class matrix, observed removals, loadout, assignment, opportunity or a validated rule.

integration: Boss ledger capability_refs resolve into this catalog for coordinator research. guidance_lint does not resolve these references into allowed support keys; no capability certificate or production advice is enabled.
